To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
chromatin protamination, as evaluated by CMA3 staining, and CATSPER, a sperm specific calcium channel, are predictors of ARTs outcomes.
the two parameters, CATSPER expression and CMA3 positivity, are able to predict ART outcomes in a large cohort of couples.

chromatin protamination, as evaluated by CMA3 staining, and CATSPER protein expression in spermatozoa are two independent predictors of embryo quality after ARTs programs, and CATSPer expression also predicts clinical pregnancy.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the identification of sperm parameters, CMA3 and CATSPER, able to predict ARTs success and useful for patient counseling.
the identification of parameters predicting ART success and the development of a model able to predict good quality embryos.
identifying new parameters that could be used in the future to improve the success of ART procedures.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
CATSPER expression and protamination are two sperm parameters that can predict ARTs success.
CATSPER expression and CMA3 staining in spermatozoa may represent useful tools to predict the quality of embryos obtained by ARTs.
CMA3 staining, CATSPER expression and other factors are useful tools to predict clinical outcomes of ART programs and to counsel couples.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
CATSPER expression is a marker of sperm quality that predicts ART outcomes.
chromatin protamination and CATSPER are useful tools to predict embryo quality after ART programs.
the combination of CATSPER and CMA3 staining may represent two simple and applicable tools for the prediction of ART success and useful tools for counseling couples.
The main takeaway from our work is that
sperm chromatin and CATSPER are important predictors of ARTs outcome, and that these sperm parameters can be used as predictors of ART success.
sperm chromatin maturity and CATSPER are important parameters for predicting ARTs success.
CATSPER expression can predict ART outcomes and may be used as a tool to predict the success of ART procedures.
